agent-settings-many-description: Share with one or more people, teams, or departments.
agent-settings-audience-description: Anyone matching at least one selected person, team, or department can use this agent. The creator and Agent Admins always keep access.
agent-settings-audience-people-descripti: Selected people can use this agent.
agent-settings-audience-teams-descriptio: Members of selected teams can use this agent.
agent-settings-audience-departments-desc: Anyone assigned to a selected department can use this agent.
agent-edit-dialog-description: Change this agent's model, provider, and behavior. Changes apply to new messages immediately.
agent-edit-dialog-open-full-description: Edit every setting on the Agents page
provider-scope-personal-description: Only your requests can use these credentials. Secret values are never returned to the browser.
provider-scope-organization-description: Organization credentials are the fallback for users without a personal key and for background workflows.
provider-personal-key-required: API key is required for a personal provider
general-settings-description: Manage the erxes API connection, agent memory, and file attachments.
general-settings-api-url-description: Used by erxes tools to send requests to the GraphQL gateway.
general-settings-memory-description: Stores chat history and powers recent-history replay, semantic recall, and working memory. Turning this off disables those features for every agent; individual agents can still opt out.
general-settings-attachments-description: Let people add images, PDFs, spreadsheets, and documents to agent chat.
general-settings-storage-description: Uses the existing storage configured in Settings → File upload.
general-settings-storage-missing-descrip: Configure storage in Settings → File upload before enabling attachments.
